contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 20,550.00' on p2, equal to the cover's This Report cell ($20,550.00)
contributions.detail: 4 Form A rows (20,000.00 + 250.00 + 100.00 + 200.00) sum to 20,550.00 exactly = the schedule's printed total = the cover's This-Report column. The cover's Cumulative cell is 88,152.04, so the schedule is PERIOD-scoped (May 27 - June 15 window) behind a cumulative cover and the earlier cycle is not itemized here. NO figure was synthesized by differencing covers, and note that on THIS filing you could not do so even if you tried: the filer's 'Last Report' column repeats the PREVIOUS report's This-Report figures (24,000.00) instead of its cumulative, so last + this (44,550.00) does not equal the printed cumulative (88,152.04). That is a FILER ERROR on the cover, retained verbatim; it does not touch this side, which gates on the This-Report cell the filer did print correctly. 2026 3-line variant: no separate <=$50 aggregate line. No in-kind rows on Form A, so both in-kind conventions agree.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report): 36,573.66' on p3, equal to the cover's This Report cell (36,573.66)
expenditures.detail: 13 Form B rows sum to 36,573.66 exactly = the schedule's printed total = the cover's This-Report column; Cumulative is 87,158.67, so period-scoped. IN-KIND TESTED BOTH WAYS: row 3 is tagged '- INKIND' by the filer (Reagan Outdoor Advertising, 1,000.00) and is INCLUDED - monetary-only would give 35,573.66 and miss the printed total by exactly that 1,000.00. Weber's in-kind convention therefore holds on the EXPENDITURE side too for this filer, which is worth recording: the in-kind tag appears on Form B here, not on Form A.
